findingDetails.title: The Pi compaction adapter duplicates the purpose interface and reaches past the runtime API for the problem formatter
findingDetails.scopeProof: Every cited file is in the 34-file target: api/index.ts, session-prime.ts, session-compact-context.ts and packet-purpose.ts.
findingDetails.claim: The public runtime API is not the contract the two compaction adapters compile against: the Pi adapter redeclares PacketPurpose and deep-imports the internal module, and formatPacketProblem is used by both adapters without a public export.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether runtime hooks conventionally deep-import lib modules and whether formatPacketProblem is exported under another name; api/index.ts exports only formatPacketPurpose and resolvePacketPurpose.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The dynamic import may be deliberate to avoid loading node:fs at Pi hook startup; that explains the import style but not the duplicated interface or the missing public export.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If deep imports are the documented convention for runtime hooks and the inline structural type is deliberate, the impact narrows to an API-documentation advisory.
